title: crataegus punctata var. pausiaca
intro: Crataegus punctata var. pausiaca, commonly known as the Himalayan hawthorn, is a variety of the hawthorn plant species that is native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan hawthorn are attributed to its ability to dilate blood vessels, improve cardiac function, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
